title: Proxy log line (contract v0.1)
description: One line of data/runs/<match_id>/proxy.jsonl (staged at data/runs/live/proxy.jsonl during a match), written by nginx. Blue's ONLY input. No schema_version/match_id because nginx writes it. A line whose request_id is missing or empty is stray traffic: loaders skip and count it, never crash. Any other line failing this schema (including a malformed request_id) is invalid.
